griidc-adt-speed-core-nansen.citation: DUACS (2025), Gridded absolute dynamic topography – Gulf subset – daily time series 1993–2019, GRIIDC.
griidc-adt-speed-core-nansen.access: Immutable original NetCDF SHA-verified and processed only in the cloud on one low-priority CPU, one daily slice. Original report pages 102 and 105 and the diagnostic image actually reviewed. Nineteen geometry/speed-core tests passed. Qualified core and numerical range only; no physical outer boundary or seasonal envelope.

records.case_label: Nansen dated source-case speed core; physical identity unverified
records.source_locator: Original DUACS daily ADT June 10, 2001; Rowe and Kennicutt (2009), MMS 2009-039, printed page 83 / PDF page 105, named approximate Nansen center; Figure 8-3, printed page 80 / PDF page 102, June 10 SSH map.
records.definition: Spherical area inside the maximum circum-averaged geostrophic-speed contour.
records.scope: OSW-derived speed-core diagnostic for this dated named source case. Physical registry crosswalk unverified; no neighboring/secondary values inherited.
records.qualification: Maximum perimeter-averaged geostrophic speed selects a core contour. Fixed 0.005/0.0025 m level steps pass convergence gates; their range plus outward rounding is numerical only, not physical uncertainty or an annual range. Mapping, MDT and gradient/interpolation errors remain unquantified; sampling/support and search radius are not effective resolution or positional accuracy. Core radius is not outer radius; bounding arcs are not principal width; mean geostrophic speed is not a local current maximum or direct ADCP observation. Nansen center is reported approximately; the June map, registry April separation and other reports May formation remain distinct definitions. No physical continuity, full footprint, state containment, ranking, playback or exact lifetime inferred.
